Jason and Lucia begin GTA VI wanting to give their relationship another chance

Rob Nelson says the player’s choices will help determine whether they stay together

Rockstar Games officially announced the first GTA 6 trailer 3 years ago today.

After years of anticipation and waiting, we are now just 10 days away from finally playing GTA 6.

3 years ago today, Rockstar’s president Sam Houser officially announced the first GTA 6 trailer.

Next week, the game finally releases.

All 4 potential unreleased GTA 6 score tracks.

3 of them were heard during Justice’s Pacha Set as unreleased tracks in September, which also featured “Pusher” before its public release.

The 4th track was heard in the Limited Edition DualSense trailer, and in the gameplay clip
